mathematical_change: A physical cross block of rank r gives exact bank-level L2 bilinear Fourier decay. Rank 3 yields a bounded continuous density with cost 6 Delta_3^-1/3 under product-projection caps. Rank 2 yields a uniform half-Riesz bound; one disjoint square innovation then yields an essentially bounded density, even with a base-dependent translation of that square.
